description: This file defines the PimReportAPI class, which extends ReportAPI to provide a REST API interface for generating and validating PIM Reports within the OrangeHRM system. It manages report retrieval, validation rules, and service instantiation specific to PIM reports.

classes.name: PimReportAPI
classes.description: API class for managing PIM reports, extending the core ReportAPI to handle specific report retrieval, validation, and generation for PIM-related data.

methods.name: getReportGeneratorService
methods.description: Lazily instantiates and returns the ReportGeneratorService used to verify report types.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Retrieves the specific report instance based on request parameters, throwing exception if report name is invalid.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for retrieving a specific report, ensuring report ID is positive and valid.
